recentItems.title: Aneet Padda-Ahaan Panday’s Goofy Dance Moves Go Viral, ‘Saiyaara’ Actress Deletes It Later
recentItems.description:
Ahaan Pandey and Aneet Padda have become one of the most talked-about young pairs after the massive success of Saiyaara. While both actors prefer keeping a low profile on social media, their fan pages closely follow their updates. And now, a hilarious dance video featuring the duo has taken the internet by storm. Aneet Padda recently shared the funny clip on Instagram, featuring her and Ahaan Pandey dancing to Gali Gali from Yash’s KGF. The two actors seemed completely playful as they tried to recreate the steps from a viral family dance video.
